en.title: emtricitabine: 2.4 and 2.5 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: 2.4 reads “0–3 months of age”. 2.5 reads “3 months through 17 years of age”. Example: An infant aged exactly 3 months matches both sections, with doses of 3 mg per kg and 6 mg per kg. The same text is in 4 labels from 4 labelers in the DailyMed release of 29 October 2026.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: low; careful reading of the whole label usually resolves it. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
